findings.title: Direct optimized review scripts lose their assertions
findings.evidence: Both audit A and audit B accept deliberately false wedge-square assertions when executed directly with -O; normal and forced optimize=0 execution reject. The historical wrapper passes its assertion guard and compiles checker sources with optimize=0.
findings.publication_action: Preserve the historical caveat; new entry point must continue forced optimize=0.

findings.title: Finite regular-file inventory is not a filesystem safety profile
findings.evidence: An unlisted FIFO is accepted. A listed README FIFO blocks until the audit child is killed after 2 seconds. No pre-read regular-file or size bound exists in the old wrapper.
findings.publication_action: A strict new entry point must reject all nonregular objects before reads and enforce a closed bounded inventory.

findings.title: Checker replay inherits ambient Python import environment
findings.evidence: An owned PYTHONPATH sympy.py poison causes direct normal checker failure; -I direct checker ignores it. Even outer-wrapper -I fails its normal checker child under that environment.
findings.publication_action: Use cold isolated children, sanitized environment, and forced optimize=0; do not claim an OS sandbox.

findings.title: Filesystem and declared Git modes are not enforced
findings.evidence: Changing README mode to 0755 or inserting ignored git_mode=120000 metadata leaves old verify() passing. Independent original authentication separately confirms all 24 Git modes 100644 and disk modes 0644.
findings.publication_action: Enforce coherent expected regular modes in a new strict profile, or keep claims limited to authenticated bytes.

findings.title: Manifest scalar schema accepts numerically equal floats
findings.evidence: Integral float payload size and float problem_id=30004549.0 are accepted. Malformed JSON, array root, missing schema, null entry, and boolean size were rejected, sometimes by uncaught structural exceptions.
findings.publication_action: Validate exact scalar types excluding bool and float, required keys, and coherent metadata in a new strict entry point.

findings.title: ZIP helper does not enforce member modes or decompression caps
findings.evidence: Direct check_archive() accepts a symlink external attribute with original member bytes and a bounded 262144-byte highly compressed fixture. It never extracts files. Full verify() protects the historical seven-member archive using frozen archive SHA256.
findings.publication_action: A strict new entry point should bound archive/member sizes, check member modes and names, and avoid extraction; no zip bomb was executed.

findings.title: Manifest envelope needs an independent trust anchor
findings.evidence: Coherently changing README plus manifest and sidecar passes the old driver while changing PUBLIC_MANIFEST SHA256. The documented independent manifest pin rejects that rebind; this audit authenticated that pin and wrapper pin before execution.
findings.publication_action: Retain an externally supplied expected manifest/entry-point hash or immutable Git binding; sidecars are not signatures.

remaining_gaps: Global compactification, cohomological independence, and smooth global geometry are assigned to separate mathematical families.
Primary-source scope, priority, novelty, and native author-turn history are not certified by this family.
A new strict publication entry point, if created, requires its own fresh audit; the historical wrapper is not relabeled as repaired.
Only supplied CPython 3.14.6/SymPy 1.14.0 on this host was executed; README's full Python 3.10+ portability range was not tested.
preserved_failures: AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE_INITIAL.json: supplied nested-statement hash initially treated as full-record hash; resolved by parent metadata correction.
HARNESS_INITIAL_FAILURE.json: own runtime-path parent error before target execution.
HARNESS_IMPORT_CACHE_FAILURE.json: import-cache contamination in owned clone caused old wrapper rejection; rerun with bytecode writes disabled.
scope: Finite authenticated byte/package reproduction and independent local symbolic checks; no OS sandbox, formal proof, human peer review, novelty certification, or priority claim.
